summary.title: Resyst Labs LLM Benchmark Rankings
summary.formula: Overall = average of measured major lanes: Full/Agentic, SWE MVP, and Hard Intelligence when published
summary.public_note: Local and API-backed models share one tournament table. Blank Hard Intelligence cells mean that lane is not yet measured for that entrant.

notes: Full/Agentic, SWE, and Hard Intelligence are separate benchmark lanes; overall uses the average of measured major lanes.
Hard Intelligence measures active inquiry, online adaptation, evidence-driven self-repair, and authority/salience integrity.
Provider, runtime, cost, latency, and reliability metadata are exposed for auditability.
Local entrants are marked with a Local model badge and ranked in the same unified tournament table as API-backed entrants.
SWE rows use the software-engineering MVP suite and are distinct from SWE-bench Verified.
Arena replays publish board states, legal actions, events, and tactical telemetry while excluding raw model completions.
